# NL SQL Analyst

> A natural-language-to-SQL analyst powered by a plugged-in language model, with read-only guardrails and result verification. Questions become SQL that is validated before it runs and executed against a real SQLite database.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst

## Source

- [src/nl_sql_analyst/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/__init__.py): NL SQL Analyst - natural-language questions answered with guarded SQL.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/analyst.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/analyst.py): The analyst pipeline: question to SQL to guardrail to execution to verified result.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/cli.py): Command line interface for the natural-language-to-SQL analyst.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/data.py): A labeled benchmark of questions with a reference SQL for ground-truth answers.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/database.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/database.py): An in-memory SQLite database with a small analytics schema and sample data.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/evaluation.py): Evaluation: answer accuracy against reference SQL and guardrail block rate.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/guardrails.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/guardrails.py): Guardrails that validate generated SQL before it is executed.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/provider.py): The language-model provider interface, a deterministic fake, and a real client.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the natural-language-to-SQL analyst.
- [src/nl_sql_analyst/translate.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/nl-sql-analyst/blob/main/src/nl_sql_analyst/translate.py): A deterministic keyword-based natural-language-to-SQL translator.
